verdict: Ad returns dropped sharply this week; spend is being pulled back now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads generated $7,148.81 in revenue on $1,485.91 in spend, a 4.81x return — but that headline number is being held up by a single spike day and does not reflect how the last week performed. Return on ad spend fell 70% week-over-week while spend rose 28%, with purchases down 21% in the same stretch, confirming the current budget level is producing diminishing returns. Ad spend per day is being reduced and creative is being reassessed to stabilise efficiency before scaling again. Separately, your Google Business Profile went dark for five consecutive days (Sep 6–10) with no actions recorded; this is being investigated and resolved as a priority. Next period you should expect steadier, lower-volume ad activity while both issues are addressed.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend over the last 28 days, though this is directional — one revenue spike day accounts for a meaningful share of the total
drop in return on ad spend this past week versus the week prior, driven by rising spend and falling purchases
Google Business Profile actions this period (calls, directions, web clicks), though activity went to zero the last five days of the window

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile showed zero activity for five straight days (Sep 6–10), a sharp break from the 23–47 daily actions recorded before — consistent with a listing or profile issue, not ad performance.
watch_item.fix: The profile is being audited and any suspension or listing error resolved this week.
